PACE_code.scope_note: public code confirms the PACE actuator/SysID implementation; it does not publish the complete paper locomotion training configuration

actor_order: base linear velocity in body frame [3]
base angular velocity in body frame [3]
encoder joint position in canonical order [12]
previous policy action in canonical order [12]
value.normalization: fixed LeggedGym observation component scales; no empirical running normalization
value.noise: independent uniform noise; commands and previous action have zero noise

observation.source_locator: PACE paper Sec. 2.3.1; LeggedGym legged_robot_config.py lines 144-162 and legged_robot.py compute_observations/_get_noise_scale_vec
observation.confidence: high for dimensions/components; medium for encoding/scales/noise distribution
observation.notes: PACE specifies i.i.d. noise but not public amplitudes/distribution; LeggedGym values are inherited. Height grid uses 21x14 centered points to satisfy the public 294-value dimensional constraint. With collapse_fixed_joints=true, each fixed FOOT link is represented by its parent *_SHANK rigid body, so the four runtime foot contact/velocity channels use the four *_SHANK bodies.

value.mapping: frozen LocomotionTargetAdapter produces an absolute target, then frozen PACEActuatorCore PD/saturation/delay semantics are applied

action.source_locator: PACE paper Eq. 8-9; Stage 0 target_adapter.py/actuator.py; LeggedGym anymal_c_rough_config.py control/init_state
action.confidence: high for mapping/core; medium for scale/default pose/decimation
action.notes: Stage 0 target adapter and actuator files are not modified. The 3-step actuator FIFO advances at every 400 Hz physics step while one policy target is held for four physics steps.

value.standing: sampled planar norm <=0.2 is zeroed; heading/yaw is unchanged

commands.notes: PACE public materials name vx/vy/yaw-rate commands but do not publish the sampling ranges or resampling interval.

rewards.name: energy
rewards.notes: ANYmal motor constant, resistance and gear ratio needed for P_el are confidential in Table 2. The fixed public reconstruction uses 1.0 W/Nm^2 and does not claim source confirmation. ANYmal k_regen=0 is source-confirmed.

rewards.name: collision
rewards.definition: 1 if any thigh-environment contact or joint hard-limit violation, else 0

rewards.name: foot_touchdown
rewards.definition: sum of maximum foot speed over current and previous two policy steps for feet touching down now

reward_timing.value: after all four physics substeps: refresh state, update commands/pushes, check termination, compute reward on terminal pre-reset state, reset done envs, compute returned observations

penalty_schedule.value: kappa=1-exp(-ln(2)*iteration/500) applied to energy and FTD
penalty_schedule.notes: The paper calls 500 iterations typical and task-dependent; this baseline freezes it at 500.

value.reset_dof_position: q_encoder=default pose*independent uniform[0.5,1.5], then q_true=q_encoder+frozen Stage 0 encoder bias

reset_termination.source_locator: LeggedGym legged_robot_config.py env; anymal_c_rough_config.py asset; legged_robot.py check_termination/reset_idx/_reset_dofs/_reset_root_states

value.terrain: 10x20 trimesh curriculum: smooth slope, rough slope, stairs up/down, discrete boxes

terrain_domain_randomization.source_locator: PACE paper Sec. 2.3; LeggedGym legged_robot_config.py terrain/domain_rand and terrain.py
terrain_domain_randomization.confidence: high for enabled categories; medium for inherited numeric values

value.entropy: PACE tanh schedule: initial 0.01, final 0.001, center iteration 750, rate 0.01

ppo.source_locator: LeggedGym legged_robot_config.py LeggedRobotCfgPPO; rsl_rl v1.0.2 PPO/OnPolicyRunner; PACE paper Sec. 2.3.4 Eq. 21-22
ppo.confidence: high for inherited PPO; low for entropy schedule numeric parameters
ppo.notes: PACE does not publicly state E0, E_inf, eta or transition iteration. Values are frozen before training and were not chosen using training outcomes.

evaluation.value: deterministic final-checkpoint actor mean; seeds 0/1/2; five fixed command cases; 20 complete episodes per command/seed; plane primary plus separately reported frozen terrain suite; observation noise and pushes disabled
evaluation.notes: PACE public materials do not publish a complete checkpoint-selection and seed evaluation protocol. This protocol is frozen before PPO and cannot be changed based on outcomes.

unresolved_assumptions.source_locator: PACE paper Table 2 marks required ANYmal motor values confidential
unresolved_assumptions.notes: Dominant unresolved reward fidelity risk; do not relabel source-confirmed.
PACE fixes 400 Hz simulation/actuator control but does not publish the locomotion policy rate or scale.

unresolved_assumptions.source_locator: PACE Sec. 2.3.1 and LeggedGym legged_robot.py height observations
unresolved_assumptions.notes: The public span/resolution/dimension do not uniquely determine endpoint placement.

unresolved_assumptions.source_locator: PACE paper only gives schedule form
unresolved_assumptions.notes: Frozen before training; no outcome-based selection.
PACE says standard practice and lists randomized categories but does not publish all numeric values.
